truth: Beyond Tamriel's coast lie five distant lands reached only by chartered expedition ships from the great ports of the Empire and the Dominion: frozen Atmora in the polar north, four-crowned Akavir across the Padomaic Ocean, the shattered desert mesas and drowned shoals of Yokuda in the west, mist-veiled Pyandonea in the southern sea, and the living coral atoll of Thras. None of these lands are ordinary provinces; each is an expeditionary frontier where outsiders cling to a single anchorage or treaty post, trading for relics, star-charts, serpent steel, or forbidden reagents while ancient cataclysms and hostile courts press against the perimeter.

atmora.truth: Atmora—Altmora, the Elder Wood of myth—is a continent locked in terminal glaciation north of the Sea of Ghosts. No living hearth burns inland; what remains are petrified frost-forests, cyclopean dragon-totem halls half-swallowed by blue glacier tongues, and the frozen dead of the last ships that failed to sail south with Ysgramor. Only seasonal salvage crews and dragon-cult scholars from Windhelm and Solitude camp on its southern basalt shingle, watching the pack-ice leads before winter locks the sea and the unthawed king in Jylkurfyk calls the frost-dead against the anchorage.

akavir.truth: Akavir, the Dragon Land across the Padomaic Ocean, is a mysterious eastern continent of four warring realms where human populations were long ago absorbed or ruled by immortal serpent-folk, thawing snow-demons, hospitable monkey-islanders, and tiger-dragon monks. Outsiders from Tamriel are permitted only in a single open treaty-harbour in Tang Mo and a strictly guarded factor's compound in Tsaesci; beyond those treaty gates lie mist-hung bamboo cloud-mountains, red-scale river fortresses, stepped golden plateaus, and the thawing glacier passes of Kamal where Emperor Uriel V's Tenth Legion lost its eagle standard at Ionith.

yokuda.truth: Yokuda is the shattered western archipelago of a sunken continent across the sea from Hammerfell: flat-topped red sandstone mesas, drowned white-marble causeways visible beneath clear turquoise shoals, and brass star-observatories left from the high age before the forbidden Pankratosword split the land in 1E 792. Redguard pilgrims, sword-singers, and Sentinel chart-captains sail here to walk the Ancestor Steps at New Tava Anchorage, while sworn Ankh-Keepers guard the half-submerged Na-Totambu tombs against plunderers and a rogue Ansei seeker trying to unseal the fault where the continent broke.

pyandonea.truth: Far south of Summerset beyond a wall of perpetual warm sea-fog lies Pyandonea, the veiled tropical jungle-and-reef archipelago of the Maormer Sea Elves and their deathless wizard-monarch King Orgnum. Giant kelp forests, bioluminescent basalt cliffs, and fleet harbours lashed from sea-serpent bone and translucent kelpsail shelter the armadas that raid Auridon every generation. At the outer truce-anchorage, foreign privateers holding temporary ivory tokens trade for black pearls and serpent-scale mail while a mutinous fleet-lord prepares a lightning storm-ritual to break the truce and strike Summerset's open ports.

thras.truth: West of Summerset and south-west of the Iliac Bay rises the Coral Kingdom of Thras: a ring atoll of living, calcified pink-and-bone coral spires, bottomless brine sinkholes, and sacrificial lagoons ruled by the amphibious, calculating Sload. Only licensed alchemy-ships and Bend'r-mahk wreck-hunters dare anchor on its quarantined outer sandbar, where Sload factors deal in literal blood-and-pearl bargains for Sload soap and abyssal pearl-glass while a deep-vent cabal cultivates a second strain of the Thrassian plague in flooded bioluminescent ziggurats beneath Agonir Lagoon.

ice_waste.truth: The Ice Waste is the northernmost glacial shield of Atmora: a mile-high dome of blue continental ice descending to black basalt shingle beaches where Windhelm charter vessels moor in brief mid-summer pack-ice leads. Frost giants, snow whales, ice wraiths and white sabre cats roam the crevasses around fortified Kjolvik Anchorage, while Nord salvage crews dig for pure stalhrim and ancient bronze beneath polar auroras, and subglacial brine rivers flow past cyclopean stone meadhalls entombed when the Great Freeze overtook the continent after the last ships sailed south.

frozen_forest.truth: In the sheltered southern basalt fjords of Atmora stands the Frozen Forest: whole silent valleys of ancient pines and elder trees flash-frozen in crystalline rime ice around the cyclopean ruined shipyard-city of Jylkurfyk. Here Ysgramor's Five Hundred Companions hewed the keels of the Return before the Great Freeze closed the harbour slips forever. Today Winterhold chroniclers and chartered relic-hunters trace the old totem road through the petrified trunks while an unthawed dragon-priest in Jylkurfyk Great Barrow stirs the frost-dead from their ice-sealed tier-tombs.

tsaesci.truth: Tsaesci is the south-western realm of Akavir: a country of terraced red-earth river basins, stepped lacquer irrigation canals, and crimson reed plains ruled by the immortal vampire serpent-courts. Foreigners from Tamriel may not pass beyond the walled coastal factor's compound without a bronze tally-seal, where chartered Ebonheart factors trade for folded-steel blades and red lacquerware. Just inland stand the dual-layer ruins of Ionith, where Emperor Uriel V's Tenth Legion died under arrow-rain in 3E 288 above a subterranean Tsaesci blood-forge and scale-citadel.

kamal.truth: Kamal is the northern ice-hell of Akavir: jagged black volcanic crags and hanging glaciers locked in nine months of howling blizzard until the violent annual spring thaw melts the high passes and looses the snow-demon hosts southward toward Tang Mo and Tsaesci. A single fortified stone watch-camp above the thaw line monitors the roaring meltwater torrents and glacier tongues, where armoured ice-beetles, snow predators, and Kamal vanguard warbands gather in rime-tempered iron around volcanic-heated subterranean steam-bastions in memory of Ada'Soom Dir-Kamal's Second Era march.

tang_mo.truth: Tang Mo is the Land of the Thousand Monkey Isles: vertical limestone karst pillars wrapped in warm monsoon cloud-mist, giant green bamboo forests, wind-bell pinnacle shrines, and curved tile-and-bamboo pavilions perched high above calm turquoise straits. Its coastal treaty harbour is the one port in all Akavir where Tamrielic charter ships from Ebonheart are welcomed openly, exchanging spice, tea, and silk while brave Tang Mo ranger clans and allied Ka Po' Tun envoys defend the high suspension bridges against Kamal thaw-raiders and Tsaesci privateers.

ka_po_tun.truth: Ka Po' Tun is the high sun-baked sandstone plateau of the Tiger-Dragon Empire in central and eastern Akavir: wide golden grass steppes, deep rock-cut stepwells, stepped golden-stone temples, and bronze-gong courts ruled by the divine tiger-dragon Tosh Raka, who transformed himself into the largest dragon in the world. Connected to the Tang Mo treaty harbour by the inland treaty road, Tiger Plains Village hosts allied pilgrims and envoys who witness the strict martial discipline of the tiger-monk retainers and their eternal border vigilance against the Tsaesci serpent-courts.

yokudan_desert.truth: The Yokudan Desert is the high, dry mesa remnant of old Yokuda: sheared red sandstone tablelands cut by the 1E 792 cataclysm fault and crowned by fluted Na-Totambu columns, brass star-observatories, and rock-cut date-palm oasis cisterns. At New Tava Anchorage, charter ships from Sentinel and Stros M'Kai land Redguard pilgrims, sword-scholars, and sword-singers to walk the Ancestor Steps under cloudless starry skies, while sworn Ankh-Keepers guard the inland star-mirror fault-vaults against a rogue seeker who would wake the forbidden Pankratosword stroke.

sunken_isles.truth: Surrounding the high sandstone mesas of Yokuda lie the Sunken Isles: a warm turquoise archipelago of low coral-sand cays, half-submerged white-marble causeways, and drowned city plazas where fluted domes rise out of the clear tide. Sentinel salvage divers and chart-captains camp at Riven Shoal Anchorage on the outer limestone shoals to recover sealed Yokudan memory-stones, orichalcum ingots, and brass astrolabes from the flooded streets, watched closely by sworn Ankh-Keepers and wary of restless Ansei wardens and brass star-automata that still patrol the tide-washed colonnades.

maormer_isles.truth: The Maormer Isles of Pyandonea rise out of a perpetual warm sea-fog south of Summerset: steep volcanic jungle peaks, giant kelp lagoons, and fleet harbours built from sea-serpent bone and translucent kelpsail. Foreign ships from Tamriel may moor only at the outer Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage under a privateer truce-token to trade for black pearls and serpent-scale mail; inland past Mistveil Village stands the Sanctum of the Coiled King, where Maormer storm-callers harness lightning spires and breed sea serpents for the next armada against Auridon.

coral_kingdom.truth: The Coral Kingdom of Thras is a ring of living, calcified pink-and-ivory coral spires rising seventy blocks above a drowned volcanic caldera and Agonir Lagoon. Heavy phosphorescent salt-miasma hangs over bottomless blue sinkholes that connect the lagoon to Summerset's abyssal vents. On the quarantined outer sandbar, licensed alchemy-ships from Anvil and Lillandril trade with calculating Sload contractors for Sload soap, abyssal pearl-glass, and forbidden necromantic reagents, while inside the flooded ziggurat of the Pillar of Thras a Sload cabal tends deep-vent plague vats.

Thras is a calcified coral atoll with brine sinkholes and no terrestrial timber forests
Pyandonea's Maormer worship Immortal King Orgnum and the Coiled King, not the Imperial Divines
Yokuda's sunken vaults belong to Na-Totambu Ansei sword-singers and star-automata, not Ayleids
